headline: Chile's Third-Quarter GDP Contracts 1.1% Year-on-Year
summary: Chile's gross domestic product contracted by 1.1% in the third quarter compared to the prior year, leading analysts to adjust full-year economic growth expectations downward.
why: Chile is the world's top copper exporter, making its economic health an indicator of global industrial commodity trade.
